product_family: Behavioral analytics and digital experience intelligence platform. Products: FullStory Analytics (user behavior), Workforce (employee experience), Anywhere (data activation), StoryAI (AI insights), FullCapture (session replay), Guides & Surveys, FullStory MCP (AI integration)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 2 Report evaluates controls against Trust Services Criteria: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy, with testing of operational effectiveness over a 12-month period. Available under NDA for customers and prospective customers with executed MSA.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 3 Report is publicly available and provides independent auditor's opinion on control effectiveness.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001:2022 Information Security Management System with 93 controls implemented.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27017:2015 Cloud Security guidelines. Provides information security controls applicable to cloud services.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018:2019
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27018:2019 Protection of PII in cloud environments. Compliance requirements based on GDPR, CPRA, POPIA, and LGPD regulations.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27701 Privacy Information Management System extension to ISO 27001, enhancing security system with dozens of privacy-specific controls.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
certifications.proof_quote: FullStory is the first in behavioral data analytics to achieve ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification for Artificial Intelligence Management System with 38 controls. As stated: 'Fullstory Becomes First In Behavioral Data Analytics To Achieve ISO/IEC 42001 Certification'

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: FullStory complies with GDPR requirements and provides Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with Standard Contractual Clauses for lawful data transfers. DPA is required for customers with EU data subjects.

certifications.name: CCPA Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: FullStory provides CCPA Addendum to help customers understand CCPA compliance impacts and requirements.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: FullStory offers Business Associate Agreement (BAA) but explicitly prohibits customers from sending sensitive health data. Policy states: 'prohibit Customers from sending us any sensitive data' including medical records, diagnostic data, and genetic information. PHI allowed is limited to non-sensitive identifiers (names, emails, IP addresses). BAA serves as protection in case of misconfiguration, not authorization for health data capture.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization found in official trust center or security documentation. One search result mentioned FedRAMP but official FullStory compliance pages do not list this certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: One search result referenced CSA STAR Level 1 compliance but this is not confirmed in official FullStory trust center or comprehensive compliance documentation pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: FullStory may use aggregated and de-identified data for product improvement and analytics. The privacy policy states: 'We may use and share information in an aggregated or de-identified manner at our discretion, including for research, analysis, modeling, marketing, and improvement of our Services.' Explicit prohibition on selling customer data: 'does not sell the data of our Customers or their Users collected through the Services to third parties or otherwise share it with non-agent third parties.'
privacy.data_region: Data residency options: NA1 (North America, default, Google Cloud us-central1) and EU1 (European Union, available since August 2022, Google Cloud europe-west3). Customers can designate location at account creation.

security.name: Data Processing Model
security.value: FullStory functions as a Data Processor; customers retain sole ownership and control of their data. Customers are Data Controllers and bear responsibility for proper configuration.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Data transmitted via HTTPS/TLS (standard for web applications). Specific encryption standards documented in trust center.

security.name: Data Masking & Exclusion
security.value: Private by Default allowlist approach. Exclude (`.fs-exclude`) removes elements entirely. Mask (`.fs-mask`) replaces text with placeholder wireframe text. Unmask is default setting. Automatic exclusion of password inputs, payment card fields (`[autocomplete^=cc-]`), and hidden inputs.

security.name: Acceptable Use Policy
security.value: Prohibits collection of sensitive data including social security numbers, passwords, health information, payment card details. Violations are enforced through contractual terms.

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: General rule: data retained only as long as needed to complete purpose or as required by law. Retention depends on relationship duration, transaction completion time, data sensitivity, consent specifics, and legal obligations.

security.name: Infrastructure & Hosting
security.value: Uses Google Cloud Platform for infrastructure. Multiple global regions for data residency. Data centers in US and EU available.

security.name: Administrative Controls
security.value: Maintains appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards per Data Processing Addendum. Capped liability for failures except in cases of gross negligence or fraud.

products.name: FullStory Analytics
products.data_scope: Customer website/app behavioral data. Captures user interactions, sessions, form submissions. Subject to data masking rules.
products.notes: Core product for digital behavior capture. Features: FullCapture (complete session recording), Heatmaps, Funnels, Journey Maps, Sentiments, Rage Click detection.

products.name: FullStory Workforce
products.data_scope: Employee workflow and experience data from internal applications.
products.notes: Parallel product targeting internal tool usage and employee experience optimization.

products.name: FullStory Anywhere
products.data_scope: Customer-collected behavioral data for third-party integrations.
products.notes: Enables sharing of insights and data with external platforms and tools.

products.name: StoryAI
products.data_scope: Aggregated behavioral analytics for AI-driven recommendations.
products.notes: Uses behavioral data to identify opportunities and provide recommendations. Powered by FullStory's AI capabilities.

products.name: FullStory MCP
products.data_scope: Behavioral context for external AI tools and agents.
products.notes: Model Context Protocol integration enabling real-time behavioral context to AI systems.

products.name: Guides & Surveys
products.data_scope: Product tours, contextual surveys, NPS feedback.
products.notes: In-product guidance delivery and feedback collection.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription-based with tiered plans (Standard, Growth, Enterprise). Usage-based or contract pricing.
compare.data_residency: Flexible - customers can choose NA1 (US, default) or EU1 (EU) at account creation. Data remains in chosen region regardless of user location. Uses Google Cloud Platform.

flags: HIPAA status is complex: FullStory offers BAA but actively prohibits sensitive health data capture, limiting utility for HIPAA-regulated entities. This is a restriction, not a certification.

FedRAMP compliance was mentioned in one general search result but is NOT listed in FullStory's official trust center or comprehensive compliance documentation. This claim could not be verified from vendor primary sources.
CSA STAR Level 1 was mentioned in one search result but not confirmed in official trust center documentation.

AI training practices could be more explicit: FullStory states they use aggregated/de-identified data for 'improvement' but does not provide granular opt-out options for AI/ML model training distinct from general product improvement.
